mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT effective_perm.perm_code FROM ( SELECT p.perm_code AS perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND r.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id AND rp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN up.effect = 'DENY' THEN CONCAT('!', p.perm_code) ELSE p.perm_code END AS perm_code FROM sys_user_permission up INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = up.permission_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND up.is_deleted = 0 AND up.effect IN ('GRANT', 'DENY') ) effective_perm WHERE effective_perm.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND effective_perm.perm_code != ''
